status: Fixed in source; frozen runner publication remains required before ordinary lifecycle commands consume the repair
area: Task claim / work-admission ticket / governed commit staging
finding: When a task had a stale taskDirectionLock from an earlier claim, completeTaskClaimWithWorkAdmission minted the new work-admission ticket before replacing that lock. resolveTaskWorkAdmissionFiles therefore selected the stale lock over the explicit --files of the current claim. The resulting ticket could authorize only task lifecycle paths while the freshly written direction lock correctly named source delivery paths. Governed git commit --auto-stage then classified those source paths as foreign dirty and omitted them from the commit bundle.
expectedBehavior: A ticket minted for a write claim must authorize exactly the current explicitly admitted claim scope plus task-local lifecycle artifacts. A stale direction lock may support a renewal only when the renewal has no explicit files; it must never narrow a newly admitted explicit claim. Unclaimed task scope remains excluded.
evidenceOrRepro: The TASK-PRF-0008 claim explicitly admitted five external-benchmark source paths, and its replacement taskDirectionLock listed those paths. Its atm.workAdmissionTicket.v1 file-write grant contained only .atm/history lifecycle entries; governed commit dry-run listed all five source files under skippedExternalDirtyFiles. Regression packages/cli/src/commands/next/__tests__/claim-files-option.spec.ts seeds a lifecycle-only stale direction lock, claims only src/a.ts, and proves src/a.ts is present while unclaimed src/b.ts remains absent from the ticket grant.
containment: Quickfix commit ce731c8f4e30bbe9c604d22848197f9eec2e5da3 changes resolveTaskWorkAdmissionFiles precedence to explicit current claim files, then live direction-lock files for renewals, then task scope as final fallback. No raw Git mutation, ticket bypass, scope widening, runner rebuild, or foreign residue cleanup was used.
followUp: Publish a fresh frozen runner through the normal runner-sync lane before relying on this source repair in ordinary node atm.mjs lifecycle commands. Keep claim-files-option and scope-amendment ticket coverage in the focused regression family.
